title: Hearty Greek Chicken Pasta
description: A winey and gooey light polish dish featuring dried oregano, poached chicken and pasta, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the garlic until fragrant.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside to poach in the chicken broth.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until reduced by half.
Stir in the dried oregano and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to combine with the wine and oregano mixture.
Slice the poached chicken and add to the pasta, tossing to combine.
Stir in the feta cheese until melted and well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
